mathematical_result.endpoint_statement: For arbitrary cap-one heavy density X and independent Gaussian B,C with variances at least 1/12, Q=2XB+C^2 has a continuous density with global L-infinity norm <4.240061<3sqrt(2).
mathematical_result.finite_family: Exact cap-one product family Q_m=2XB_m+C_m^2 from one heavy row plus two m-row uniform banks; A_m has exact nonzero spectrum {1,1,-1} and all fixed heavy-bank pair determinants are -1/m.
mathematical_result.uniform_transfer: Using account04/B17 weighted local Edgeworth plus sinc/Fresnel tails, sup_f ||p_{Q_m(f)}-p_{Q_infty(f)}||_infinity -> 0, uniformly over arbitrary dimension-dependent heavy cap-one laws.
mathematical_result.sharp_constant_consequence: limsup_m sup_f ||p_{Q_m(f)}||_infinity <=4.240061<3sqrt(2)<=C_*; therefore this canonical zero-pivot one-heavy architecture cannot be a sharp lower witness.

actual_premises: One-dimensional bathtub principle for an explicitly positive even decreasing Gaussian reward in the original heavy coordinate.
Exact Gaussian characteristic functions for a bilinear Gaussian factor and a Gaussian square.
Exact sinc characteristic function for normalized sums of centered unit uniforms.
Symmetric unimodality of convolution powers of centered interval densities and a direct Fresnel interval bound.
Designated partner account04/B17 weighted local Edgeworth expansion and exact 3sqrt(2) lower-witness theorem.

partner_result.application: Its weighted Edgeworth theorem yields L1 bank-density convergence used in the actual uniform finite-to-Gaussian density-transfer inequality; its exact rotated witness gives C_*>=3sqrt(2).

continuity_scope: Continuous density proved for the Gaussian endpoint and sufficiently large exact finite-bank family only; full-target continuity remains open.
unresolved: Full QFORM universal bounded-density theorem remains open.
Two-heavy or multiple-shared-row exact no-pivot architectures are not controlled by this result.
Genuinely non-Gaussian surviving components coupled to the diffuse core remain possible witness mechanisms.
next_step: Change mechanism to a two-heavy/multiple-shared-row exact cap-one no-pivot witness family, or a coupled non-Gaussian surviving component; do not repeat one-heavy Gaussian endpoint work.
